# runany.dev

> Practical guides for AI setup, developer tools, local LLMs, self-hosted services, and automation workflows.

runany.dev is an English technical blog for developers building with AI tools and open-source infrastructure. Optimized for AI crawlers (GPT, Claude, Perplexity).

## Core Pages

- Home: https://runany.dev/
- Blog index: https://runany.dev/blog/
- RSS feed: https://runany.dev/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://runany.dev/sitemap.xml
- llms.txt: https://runany.dev/llms.txt
- llms-full.txt: https://runany.dev/llms-full.txt

## Topics

- AI agent setup and orchestration (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)
- Developer tools and open-source CLI utilities
- Local LLM inference and model serving
- Self-hosted services on VPS and Docker
- YC-backed developer tools (W26, S25, X25)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations
- Browser automation and AI agent infrastructure

## Recent Posts (Latest 30)

- [1Flow - In-App Surveys That Actually Get Responses](https://runany.dev/blog/1flow-in-product-surveys/): 1Flow embeds a JS snippet or mobile library to deliver high-response surveys inside apps. YC W22 backed, 50-70% response rate vs 5-10% for traditional methods.
- [Enact - Verified AI Tools Registry](https://runany.dev/blog/enact-verified-ai-tool-registry/): Browse, discover, and safely run AI tools with cryptographic verification. Enact is the npm for AI agents—a registry with end-to-end proofs that tools do.

- [Mercury Agent – AI Agent with Permission-Hardened Tools](https://runany.dev/blog/mercury-agent/): Mercury Agent runs 24/7 from CLI or Telegram with a personality system, token budgets, and permission-hardened tools. Built with TypeScript and Docker with BYO.
